|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Eli Vanto In Dreadnaught]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

* '''PC-E1''' ([[Eli Vanto In Dreadnaught (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf)<ref name="sheet23-20240802">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 9 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024). Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 3, file created 2 August 2024: “May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Permanent pilot is •Vanto, who provides ability of 3. Immune to attrition &lt; 4 (&lt; 6 while piloted by Thrawn or while a 'probed' or 'liberated' system on table).” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Eli Vanto In Dreadnaught]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Eli Vanto In Dreadnaught]] (published 21 July 2024) as a printable slip under the label “•Eli Vanto In Dreadnaught”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
